Collaboration leads to success. Innovation ignites growth.

```
# Team Notes

| ID | Date Added | Idea Summary | Category | Notes |
|----|------------|---------------|-----------|--------|

Collaboration leads to success. Innovation ignites growth.
```

---

| # | `ideas.txt` | `TeamNotes.txt` | Difference Explained |
|---|-------------|-----------------|----------------------|
| 1 | *Single sentence* | `# Team Notes` | Header indicating the purpose of the file. Adds context. |
| 2 | *(blank)* | *(empty line after header)* | Keeps visual separation. |
| 3 | *(blank)* | Table header line (`| ID | … |`) | Introduces structured data layout. |
| 4 | *(blank)* | Separator line (`|----|…|`) | Markdown requirement for tables. |
| 5 | *(blank)* | Empty line before content | Visual spacing. |
| 6 | Sentence about collaboration & innovation | Same sentence again | Content duplicated but now appears beneath the table. |

In short, `TeamNotes.txt` wraps the same idea inside a markdown table framework and adds a descriptive heading, whereas `ideas.txt` simply holds the raw sentence without any structural markup.
